component: Thunderbird OpenPGP partial inline message display

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The explicit subset action extracts one armored block and writes a synthetic text/plain EML to a unique 0600 temporary file. It registers exit-time deletion and routes that file through MailUtils.openEMLFile, returning before the ordinary in-place parse callback. The original partial-display reminder is removed. The changed browser test checks prefix/suffix removal, decrypted content and encryption icon state in a new message window. File routing itself does not await display or OpenPGP completion; the accepted test later waits for openpgpprocessed separately. Required Bug 1881530 and D278066 discussions are inaccessible, so this is a static source finding with zero full-audit credit.
title: Partial encrypted inline processing opens an isolated message instead of replacing the original display
